name: ATM Command 7 Code
definition: Type of command performed by the ATM.

ABAL.name: ATM Balance
ABAL.definition: Provide the ATM counters, resetting those that are applicable.

ASTS.name: ATM Status Update
ASTS.definition: Status of the ATM required by the ATM manager.

CCNT.name: Counters Inquiry
CCNT.definition: Request the value of the ATM counters.

DISC.name: Disconnect
DISC.definition: Perform a disconnection followed by a reconnection.

SCFU.name: Security Device Configuration Update
SCFU.definition: Update the configuration of the hardware security module on the ATM.

SSCU.name: Security Device Scheme Update
SSCU.definition: Update the security scheme of the hardware security module on the ATM.

SSTU.name: Security Device Status Update
SSTU.definition: Update the status of the hardware security module on the ATM.

SNDM.name: Send Message
SNDM.definition: Send a specific message to initiate a process.

HKCG.name: HLA Key Replace
HKCG.definition: Replace an existing key using a Higher Level Authority (HLA) key. In the TR34 scheme this would be used to implement a HLA Rebind operation.

HKRV.name: HLA Key Remove
HKRV.definition: Remove a cryptographic key using a Higher Level Authority key (HLA). In the TR34 scheme this would be used to implement a HLA Unbind operation.

KCHG.name: Key Replace
KCHG.definition: Replaces an existing cryptographic key. In a TR34 scheme this would be used to implement a Rebind operation.
